question: In April 2023, Wing Commander Deepika Misra received which of the following awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vayu Sena Medal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wing Commander Deepika Misra** was awarded the **Vayu Sena Medal** in April 2023.
 
• The **Vayu Sena Medal** is awarded for individual acts of exceptional devotion to duty or courage.
 
• It is one of the prestigious awards given by the Indian Air Force to recognize the bravery and dedication of its personnel.
 
• Deepika Misra's recognition highlights her exemplary service and contributions to the Indian Air Force.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Vayu Sena Medal** was established on 17 June 1960 by the President of India.
 
• This award can be given in both peacetime and wartime for acts of gallantry or distinguished service.
 
• Recipients of the Vayu Sena Medal are entitled to use the post-nominal letters "VM".
 
• Such recognitions serve to motivate and inspire other members of the armed forces to exhibit extraordinary courage and commitment.
